propositions: A new advisory, agent-tier, container-scoped plan-review criterion `decomp-shape` must detect architectural layer-cake partitioning (DB/schema, service/API, frontend/UI children) as a decomposition smell that existing criteria G3 and G4 miss.

The `decomp-shape` criterion must detect consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge patterns where a child names/consumes an artifact a sibling produces but no depends_on/blocks edge exists, risking parallel-agent scheduler violations.

The criterion must register as non-orphan in `CANONICAL_LLM` and `AGENT_TIER` (not `CODEBASE_GROUNDED`), route through `pass1_container` container fan-out, and auto-include in the standing effectiveness recorder with zero per-criterion wiring.

The criterion's advisory posture is permanent for R3; blocking promotion is deferred via double gate: (1) effectiveness metrics and (2) E6 order-stability clearing floor (fleiss_kappa >= 0.6), a declared prerequisite.
Eval_solver must extend its container-arm to run container criteria via `pass1_container` when a fixture carries a `children:` list, bounding sanity to one live container call per fixture.

Hand-authored bounded sanity fixtures (layer-cake and consumed-artifact positives, vertical-slice and ordered negatives) must achieve recall 1.0 on positives and false-accept 0.0 on negatives to prove criterion fidelity.
